verdict.rationale: Abacum's own marketing says it 'runs AI inside your model' so answers are grounded in the business's data, and describes an AI Modeler that builds financial models from plain-language prompts. The investor-reporting page also says the narrative updates automatically from actuals. These are first-party, product-level claims of in-app AI working over the user's data, but they are short marketing lines with no detail on proactive insights or suggestions. missing for 10: documentation of AI-generated insights or recommendations (e.g., variance explanations, anomaly flags), explicit confirmation that the auto-updating narrative is AI-generated, in-depth product docs on the AI features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
